newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Niaga closes US$40 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank Niaga closes US$40 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Niaga's US$40 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been closed and allotted, arranger Sumitomo Finance Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in years three and four.
The issue was priced at par to float at 80 basis points over the six-month Singapore Interbank Offered Rate.
Underwriting fees are six basis points and management fees are 30 basis points for co-arrangers.
Arrangers and lead managers with US$5 million each are Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Co-arrangers and lead managers with US$4.5 million each are Arab Bank plc, Bank of Nova Scotia, Bayerishce Vereinsbank Singapore and Gulf International Bank.
Other arrangers and lead managrs with US$4 million each, are Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft, INDOVER Bank and Tat Lee Bank.
